description: The Node player's deck in spec 19, saved as Deck 1 (deck index 0) and picked as trio slot 0 for game 2 of the series. SPEC §8 cards #41-#60: twenty distinct non-Token Core ids (L2, L3, L6), disjoint from 19-modes-a so the two players' hands can never be confused. Never played: the Node player only reads its opening hand and concedes, and nothing here puts a non-Token card into a hand at the opening.
